_about: Market-of-one (spec 3.12, 7.17). One viewer market: Cleveland, DMA 510. localTeams are the clubs whose local feeds this market receives; postalCode drives the NHL postal-lookup territory check (adapters/nhl.py). Edit here; adapters read this file directly.
